entries.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons - Dungeon Master's Guide

findings: AD&D 1e Player's Handbook TSR 2010 and Dungeon Masters Guide TSR 2011: Gemini swapped product codes
Five records cannot substantiate complete 1974-present bibliography
No primary-source URLs or citations substantiate VERIFIED claims
1974-01-01 is a fabricated day when only year is established
Constructor opens database and runs migrations; violates injected connection policy
WAL PRAGMA inappropriate for memory database and should be configured at production bootstrap
INSERT OR REPLACE overwrites records and may affect foreign keys
SQL schema loses authors setting date precision and source provenance
Historical eras have one calendar system and no setting namespace
Tests only insert and retrieve one publication; no fictional chronology checks
Existing publication index and weave chronology modules must not be replaced
next: Add read-only validator, independent tests, source-backed bibliographic review
